author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
CATL just launched TENER Sodium - the world's first field-validated sodium-ion battery built specifically for the grid. I was in Munich for the launch, and sat down with Amanda Xu, CATL's CTO for Energy Storage, to ask how you build a battery that's going to save our grid. 

Thanks for CATL for inviting me to this exciting announcement and for sponsoring this video. All opinions, content, and editorial outputs are my own.
